newsitem.title: USA: W.H. Brady FY96 below plan.
newsitem.headline: W.H. Brady FY96 below plan.

text.p: W.H. Brady Co, which makes industrial identification products and coated materials, said Tuesday its results for fiscal 1996 ended July 31 were below plan.
W.H. Brady earned $1.27 a share in fiscal 1996, even with a year ago. For the fourth quarter, it earned $0.36 a share, up from $0.33.

"The 1996 fiscal year was especially challenging with three acquisitions, heavy investments in sales and marketing and ongoing international expansion into Brazil, Korea and Mexico," Katherine Hudson, president, said in a statement. "Our full-year results were behind plan, but the fourth quarter performance began to bring us back on track."
